verbs.name: screen_record.pause
verbs.description: Request an explicit pause of a live macOS pause-safe recording. It does not return success when the command is merely sent: success follows only after the native owner seals the exact screen plus optional microphone/system-audio run and appends the durable Pause transition. There is no toggle verb. Requires the capture_id returned by an opt-in screen_record.start{pause:{mode:'enabled'}} in this cutd process. Linux and Windows return unavailable.

capture_id.description: The exact live pause-safe capture id returned by screen_record.start.

verbs.result: {capture_id, action:"pause", saved:true, state:"paused", logical_media_time_ms} — saved:true means the native run and versioned session-journal Pause transition are durable. A timeout or refusal never changes the caller-visible state.

verbs.name: screen_record.resume
verbs.description: Request an explicit resume of a live macOS pause-safe recording. It does not return success when the command is merely sent: success follows only after native readiness is accepted and the durable Resume transition is appended. There is no toggle verb. Requires the capture_id returned by an opt-in screen_record.start{pause:{mode:'enabled'}} in this cutd process. Linux and Windows return unavailable.

capture_id.description: The exact live pause-safe capture id returned by screen_record.start.

verbs.result: {capture_id, action:"resume", saved:true, state:"recording", logical_media_time_ms} — saved:true means the versioned session-journal Resume transition is durable. A timeout or refusal never changes the caller-visible state.
